purpose: Test whether a small frozen-decoder RGBA auxiliary loss reduces the nearly-static H8 failure while preserving the same corrected start-aligned M6 architecture and training budget.

frozen_model.backbone: full spatiotemporal DiT with signed local temporal and spatial 3D RoPE
frozen_model.teacher_forcing: clean ground-truth history during training; generated history during rollout
frozen_model.decoded_loss_definition: foreground-alpha-weighted RGB L1 plus alpha L1 with transparent pixels weighted 0.02; decoder frozen but differentiable

validation.primary_comparison: motion, topology, prompt sensitivity, and fixed-seed visuals versus the fresh v3 H8 2k seed-0 control
validation.claim_limit: A two-thousand-step single-seed loss ablation diagnoses training behavior; it is not a final architecture ranking.
